gitGraph.refsDescription: How the Git Graph condenses the branch and tag chips on a commit row.
gitGraph.mergeLocalRemoteLabel: Merge a branch with its remotes
gitGraph.mergeLocalRemoteHint: The branch and each remote carrying it become blocks of a single chip, with one right-click menu for both. A remote that is ahead or behind keeps its own origin/… chip.
gitGraph.hideOriginHeadHint: A symbolic link to the remote's default branch — the same commit its own branch chip already marks.
gitGraph.collapseHint: Anything past the limit hides behind a +N chip that lists the rest, so the commit message keeps its room.

workspace.blocksDescription: Choose which details each tab shows.
workspace.hookErrorTitle: Session hooks could not be updated
workspace.hookErrorMessage: Installing or removing the agent status hooks failed: {{error}}
workspace.statusTrackingDescription: Installs a Claude Code hook so cards show live status (running, thinking, needs approval) only while Claude runs in a tempo-term terminal. Other terminals are unaffected.
workspace.notificationsLabel: Desktop notification when an agent needs approval or finishes (only while the window is unfocused)
workspace.notificationsRequiresTracking: Turn on session-status tracking to enable notifications.
workspace.autoResumeDescription: Whenever tempo-term starts, resume each saved Claude Code and Codex conversation in its original pane using its exact session ID. While enabled, tempo-term keeps both agents' status hooks installed to remember session IDs. Resume may fail if the original project directory no longer exists; interrupted tool operations are not rerun.
workspace.autoResumeLabel: Automatically resume AI conversations whenever tempo-term starts
workspace.resumeWithFlagsLabel: Also apply the launcher default flags below when resuming conversations
workspace.launcherFlagsDescription: Flags added to the command when you start Claude Code or Codex from the launcher.
workspace.prDescription: Where PR status is fetched from. gh is detected automatically.
workspace.ghMissing: gh CLI not found on PATH

about.tagline: AI-powered terminal, editor and file explorer

language.label: Display language
language.description: Choose the language used across the interface
language.restartHint: Native menus in the editor and notes follow this language after you restart the app

background.label: Background image
background.description: Choose a local image for the workspace or the whole window. TempoTerm keeps a private app-managed copy, so moving the original will not break it.
background.formats: PNG, JPEG, or WebP · up to 20 MB
background.sourceImageHint: This card only identifies the source. Use the live workspace preview to judge the real interface result.
background.previewSourceError: This file cannot be previewed. Choose another PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
background.dropSingleError: Drop one image at a time.
background.opacityHint: Interface surfaces keep a theme-coloured scrim so text stays readable.
background.terminalOpacityHint: Controls terminal background visibility separately. Higher values reveal more of the image.
background.textColorHint: Overrides interface and terminal default text while the image is visible. ANSI status colours remain unchanged.
background.importOnApply: The original file will only be copied when you apply these changes.
background.removalPreviewHint: Open the live preview to inspect the workspace without a background, then apply to remove it.
background.saveError: The image could not be saved. Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file no larger than 20 MB.
background.invalidFileError: The selected image could not be read.
background.unsupportedFormatError: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
background.fileTooLargeError: Choose an image no larger than 20 MB.
background.storageError: The image could not be copied to TempoTerm's app data.
background.removeError: The saved background could not be removed.
background.loadError: The saved image could not be loaded. Replace it with another image.

fonts.label: Terminal font
fonts.description: Pick the primary monospace font; a Traditional Chinese fallback is applied automatically
fonts.iconFontHint: Optional Nerd Font / Powerline font used to render icon glyphs the primary font lacks
fonts.previewText: The quick brown fox 中文字體預覽 0123

terminalSettings.description: Adjust the gap between the terminal content and its pane edges
terminalSettings.restoreHistoryHint: Reopen each terminal with its previous output (read-only), unless its shell was exited or the pane was closed
terminalSettings.confirmCloseHint: Show a confirmation before closing a window or quitting the app while local terminal or SSH sessions are still running (enabled by default)
terminalSettings.suggestionsHint: Show a dim completion from your shell history as you type; press → to accept
terminalSettings.actionLinksHint: Hover an IP, host:port or archive in the output to get quick commands (ping, curl, extract…)
terminalSettings.customShellHint: Shell executable to spawn instead of the auto-detected default; leave empty for your system $SHELL, or point at pwsh / PowerShell 7 on Windows

aiModel.label: Default model
aiModel.description: Choose the provider and model the assistant uses by default; you can switch anytime in the chat panel
aiModel.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. https is allowed anywhere; plain http only for localhost.

aiInline.label: Inline code completion
aiInline.description: Show AI ghost-text suggestions while typing in the editor. Tab accepts, Escape dismisses. Uses your default model and counts against its usage.

aiKeys.title: API keys
aiKeys.description: Keys are stored in your OS keychain and read only by the backend, never returned to the app window
